apks.help: No APK is distributed. Build it yourself on a PC from your own arcade files with the repository's tools/quest/build_apk.sh, then pick the APK it makes.

steps.text: On your PC, run tools/quest/push_data.sh from the repository with the headset connected. It copies the game data. Then open Jurassic Park Arcade from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: Built from source: needs the Raw Thrills arcade Linux dump, Android SDK and NDK. push_data.sh pushes runtime data to Android/data/com.jp2015.vr/files/game/, but which files it pushes is not in the guide, so there is no input yet. The guide's install.sh step is install-apk here.
